name: ElephantDrive
description_en:
ElephantDrive combines cloud file backup, version history, device synchronization and sharing. Its desktop and supported NAS clients protect selected files, while the Everywhere folder synchronizes content across connected devices. These mechanisms need different deletion and recovery decisions.

A sensible evaluation starts with one important folder and an older-version restore, not an assumption that cloud synchronization protects every historical state. This profile relies on official product, plan and FAQ pages; no client or NAS package was tested.
description_zh:
ElephantDrive 提供云文件备份、版本历史、设备同步和共享。桌面及受支持 NAS 客户端保护所选文件，Everywhere 文件夹则在已连接设备之间同步内容。不同机制需要分别考虑删除和恢复。

评估宜从一个重要文件夹及旧版本恢复开始，不能假定云同步保存了每个历史状态。本文依据官方产品、套餐及 FAQ，未测试客户端或 NAS 套件。

sections.title_en: Separate the backup folder from Everywhere
sections.title_zh: 区分备份文件夹与 Everywhere
sections.en:
The FAQ describes installing and signing in, then adding folders for backup. Files placed in Everywhere synchronize through the cloud to other connected devices. Collaborative sharing uses that folder and lets members modify or delete content.

For example, keep a representative document in a backup job and another disposable copy in Everywhere. Change both and recover the earlier backup version; separately observe intended synchronization behavior. Define who may change shared content before enabling collaboration. The two paths are related product capabilities, not interchangeable recovery guarantees.
sections.zh:
FAQ 说明安装登录后添加备份文件夹；放入 Everywhere 的文件则经云端同步到其他连接设备。协作共享使用该目录，成员可以修改或删除内容。

例如，可在备份任务放一个代表性文档，在 Everywhere 放另一份可丢弃副本。分别修改后恢复备份旧版本，再单独核对预期同步行为。开启协作前需定义谁可修改共享内容。这两条路径属于相关能力，不能当作相同恢复保证。

sections.title_en: History depends on the job rules
sections.en:
The FAQ says modifications create a new current copy while retaining previous versions according to configurable versioning rules. Restore jobs also require a valid destination-device path, with spelling and case respected. Verify the destination is available and recover a sample before relying on a large emergency restore.

Deleting a device moves its backup data to trash before final deletion. Inspect archive, version and deletion rules before cleanup. Some FAQ compliance wording is historical; it is not adopted as a current legal assurance. Exact default retention, retry handling and supported NAS versions remain unverified.
sections.zh:
FAQ 说明修改会产生新的当前副本，旧版本按可配置规则保留；恢复任务需要有效的目标设备路径，并注意拼写和大小写。应先确认目标可用并恢复样例，再依赖大型紧急恢复。

删除设备会先把备份数据移入回收站，再最终清除。清理前应检查归档、版本和删除规则。部分 FAQ 合规措辞具有历史性，本文不作为当前法律保证。准确默认保留期、重试和 NAS 版本仍未确认。

sections.title_en: Capacity and individual file size both matter
sections.title_zh: 容量与单文件限制都重要
sections.en:
The current plans show Solo USD 10/month for 1,000 GB, Family USD 20/month for 2,000 GB and Business USD 40/month for 2,000 GB. Annual totals shown are USD 100, 200 and 400 respectively. Additional capacity has different rates by tier; Solo has a 10-GB individual-file limit. The Business file-size wording varies between parts of the same page, so confirm the selected configuration.

A large video may fail a file limit even when total account space remains. Shortlist ElephantDrive when supported device backup and shared-file workflows fit; verify actual file sizes, devices, subaccounts and renewal conditions. Software download and a trial are not evidence of indefinite free capacity or an open-source license.
sections.zh:
当前套餐列 Solo 每月 10 美元含 1,000 GB、Family 每月 20 美元含 2,000 GB、Business 每月 40 美元含 2,000 GB；对应年付总额为 100、200、400 美元。额外容量随套餐费率不同，Solo 单文件上限 10 GB。同一页面 Business 单文件措辞不一致，需确认所选配置。

即使账户剩余空间充足，大视频仍可能超过单文件限制。设备备份与共享流程符合需求时可考虑 ElephantDrive，但需核对文件大小、设备、子账户及续费条件。下载和试用不能证明持续免费容量或开源许可。
